该来源已有排队或运行中的作业，请等待完成后再上传。: This source has a queued/running job. Wait before uploading again.
上传中断或长时间未收到数据，请检查网络后重试。: Upload interrupted or idle too long. Check networking and retry.
导入缓存写入失败，请检查磁盘空间与缓存目录权限。: Could not write import cache. Check disk space and directory permissions.
文件超过导入限制：上传 512 MiB、解压或规范化内容 2 GiB、单条 1: File exceeds import limits: 512 MiB upload, 2 GiB extracted/normalized content, 1 MiB per record.
服务端导入缓存不可用：请在后端进程设置 NM_INTEL_CACHE_ROOT，: Server import cache unavailable. Set NM_INTEL_CACHE_ROOT for the backend process with read/write access for its account, then restart the backend. Setting it in pnpm dev has no effect.
导入缓存文件已丢失，请重新上传原始文件。: Import cache file missing. Upload the original file again.
服务端未返回有效的上传准备确认，请检查后端版本、登录状态及代理路由。文件尚未发送: No valid upload-preparation confirmation. Check backend version, session and proxy routing. No file was sent.
文件中没有支持的 IOC，请检查数据格式。: No supported IOCs in the file. Check its format.
CSV 格式无法解析：请保留原始表头、逗号分隔及完整引号；支持 ThreatFo: Cannot parse CSV. Preserve original headers, comma separators and complete quoting. ThreatFox comment headers, field whitespace and UTF-8 BOM are supported.
文件编码不是 UTF-8，请将文件转换为 UTF-8 后重新导入。: File is not UTF-8. Convert it before importing again.
JSON 结构或内容无效：支持 IOC 数组、data/iocs 数组和 Thr: Invalid JSON structure/content. Supports IOC arrays, data/iocs arrays and ThreatFox ID-grouped exports. Do not upload error pages or truncated files.
来源含无法识别的 URL IOC，请检查该条记录的格式；支持 HTTP(S)、F: Unrecognized URL IOC. Check the record. HTTP(S), FTP(S), SMB, TFTP, TCP, WS(S) and schemeless host/path forms are supported. No import occurs before complete validation.
来源记录的参考链接格式无效；参考链接应为不含账号密码的 HTTP/HTTPS 地: Invalid reference link. Use an HTTP/HTTPS URL without username/password.
该值无法规范化为域名；支持国际化域名及下划线 DNS 名称，不猜测或解码其他字符: Value cannot normalize to a domain. Internationalized domains and underscore DNS names are supported; other strings are not guessed or decoded.
该值不是有效的 IPv4 或 IPv6 地址。: Not a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address.
该值不是有效的 IP:端口；端口须在 0–65535 范围，端口 0 只按原值保: Not a valid IP:port. Port must be 0–65,535. Port zero is stored literally and does not tag the whole IP.
哈希长度或十六进制格式不符合声明的类型。: Hash length or hexadecimal format does not match its declared type.
记录的字段类型、长度、置信度或必填内容无效。: Invalid field type, length, confidence or required content.
当前不支持该 IOC 类型，原始类型已保留在异常摘要中。: Unsupported IOC type. Original type retained in malformed-record summary.
AI 提议未通过原文证据校验，请查看具体原因；未纳入有效库。: AI proposal failed original-evidence validation and was not added to the active catalog. Check the reason.
请选择基准库中类型匹配的有效 MITRE 实体。: Select a valid MITRE reference entity with the matching type.
远程抓取不能访问私网或本机地址。: Remote fetching cannot access private or local addresses.
接口地址与所选协议不匹配，请核对 Chat Completions 或 Resp: Endpoint and protocol do not match. Check Chat Completions / Responses paths.
请核对报告组织原名、处理方式和目标组织。: Check original reported organization name, action and target organization.
已存在同名组织，请搜索后选择或补充别名。: An organization with this name exists. Search/select it or add an alias.
上传被服务器或反向代理的大小限制拒绝；文件最多 512 MiB，请检查代理上传限: Upload rejected by server/proxy size limits. Maximum file size is 512 MiB; check proxy upload limits.
反向代理连接服务器失败或等待超时，请检查服务状态；上传是否已接收可在同步作业中确: Proxy connection failed or timed out. Check service status. Confirm upload receipt in sync jobs.
上传请求超时，请检查网络与反向代理超时配置后重试。: Upload timed out. Check networking and reverse proxy timeouts.
情报请求失败，请检查网络与服务器状态后重试。: Intelligence request failed. Check networking and server status, then retry.
已设置的代理环境变量（不代表实际使用）: Configured proxy environment variables (not proof of use)
引用不是正文中的连续原文: Quote is not contiguous original text
引用的正文块不存在: Quoted body block does not exist
所选原文证据单元不存在或不适用于该 IOC 类型: Selected original evidence unit does not exist or does not apply to this IOC type
引用未包含该 IOC 的完整值: Quote lacks the complete IOC value
上下文与 IOC 不属于同一列表范围: Context and IOC are outside the same list scope
上下文字段不能支持该 IOC 的恶意结论: Context field does not support a malicious conclusion for this IOC
应引用该 IOC 所属记录的标题: Quote the heading of the IOC's own record
上下文属于另一条资产记录: Context belongs to another asset record
只有 IOC 值，缺少支持其角色的上下文: Only the IOC value is present; context supporting its role is missing
历史规则判定引用过短: Quote too short under historical rules
模型或上游模型路由不可用: Model or upstream model route unavailable
提供方报告接口路由不存在: Provider reports no such API route
JSON 模式要求提示词明确包含 JSON 字样: JSON mode requires the prompt to explicitly mention JSON
无法从安全分类确定原因: Cannot determine cause from safe classification
回复被 Markdown 代码围栏包裹: Response is wrapped in Markdown code fences
回复以思考文本标签开头: Response starts with a reasoning-text tag
仅返回独立推理内容，缺少最终回复: Only separate reasoning returned; final reply missing
操作不在当前目录中：{0}: Operation missing from the current catalog: {0}
{0}应为 {1}～{2} 的整数: {0} must be an integer from {1} to {2}
基于查询时保留的数据: Based on data retained at query time
留空由后台抓取；也可粘贴完整正文和表格，核对序号、IP、ASN 与上下文。: Leave blank for server fetching, or paste the complete body and tables. Check numbering, IPs, ASNs and context.
输入调试消息，Enter 发送，Shift+Enter 换行: Enter a debug message; Enter sends, Shift+Enter inserts a line break
留空使用事件默认收件人: Leave blank to use default event recipients
可选：说明本次调整目的；该内容会写入版本历史和审计日志。: Optional: describe the change. Recorded in version history and audit logs.
例如：数据库升级与索引维护: E.g. database upgrade and index maintenance
输入 IPv4/CIDR、IPv6/CIDR 或域名；多个目标使用逗号或换行分隔: Enter IPv4/CIDR, IPv6/CIDR or domains; separate targets with commas or line breaks
扫描统计基于已处理且保留的统计事实；处理水位不保证查询范围完整。: Scan statistics use processed and retained facts; the processing watermark does not guarantee complete coverage of the query period.
IP 在每个分组内去重，周期去重数独立计算，不能累加分组数量。: IPs are deduplicated within each group. Period-wide unique IPs are calculated separately and cannot be obtained by summing groups.
端口、服务按执行内代表性端点计数，跨执行累加，不代表当前资产存量。: Ports and services count representative endpoints within each execution and accumulate across executions; they do not represent current asset inventory.
扫描统计基于查询时保留且已索引的观测，按 IP 或执行端点精确去重。: Scan statistics use observations retained and indexed at query time, with exact deduplication by IP or execution endpoint.
端口、服务计数不代表当前资产存量。: Port and service counts do not represent current asset inventory.
新建任务按创建时间归属，完成任务及执行按结束时间归属，取消单列。: New tasks are attributed by creation time; completed tasks and executions by end time. Cancellations are counted separately.
成功率 = 成功 /（成功 + 失败 + 部分完成），无分母显示 --。: Success rate = succeeded / (succeeded + failed + partially completed). Displays -- when the denominator is zero.
任务按逻辑任务去重；扫描器按执行实例计数。耗时仅包含有效起止时间的成功执行。: Tasks are deduplicated by logical task; scanners count execution instances. Durations include only successful executions with valid start and end times.
统计基于查询时保留的历史。: Statistics use history retained at query time.
基于保留数据的前一等长日历周期；历史完整性未确认，差异不代表资产新增。: Comparison uses retained data from the previous calendar period of equal length. Historical completeness is unconfirmed; differences do not indicate new assets.
明细为保留的快照事实；IP 可能在不同执行中重复出现。: Details show retained snapshot facts; IPs may appear in multiple executions.
明细为保留的原始观测，可能重复且会随索引更新；不等于去重汇总条数。: Details show retained raw observations, which may repeat and change as the index updates; row counts do not equal deduplicated summary counts.
任务按创建或结束时间入选；执行按结束时间入选。: Tasks are selected by creation or end time; executions are selected by end time.
清除应用密钥（同时清空应用 ID）: Clear app secret (also clear the app ID)
配置飞书自建应用凭据后，报告趋势图会先上传飞书，再发送到此机器人。未配置时发送文: Configure Feishu custom app credentials to upload report charts to Feishu before sending them to this bot. Without credentials, reports are sent as text.
清除飞书应用密钥时请同时清空应用 ID。: Clear the Feishu app ID when clearing its secret.
飞书应用 ID 与密钥须同时配置。: Configure both the Feishu app ID and secret.
无法连接飞书应用认证服务: Cannot connect to the Feishu app authentication service
飞书应用认证失败，请检查应用凭据: Feishu app authentication failed; check the app credentials
飞书图片上传失败，请检查应用权限和网络: Feishu image upload failed; check app permissions and network access
报告趋势图生成失败，请检查归档数据: Report chart generation failed; check the archived data
选择邮件收件人或已启用的通知渠道，发送当前归档版本。发送失败可能自动重试，重复发: Select email recipients or enabled notification channels to send the current archived report. Failed deliveries may be retried and repeated sends may create duplicates.
没有可用管理员邮箱。: No administrator email addresses are available.
没有已启用的飞书或 Telegram 渠道。: No enabled Feishu or Telegram channels are available.
勾选后订阅该周期的报告生成事件；修改也会同步到通知渠道。: Select channels to subscribe to report generation for this period. Changes are also reflected in notification channels.
没有可用的飞书或 Telegram 渠道。请启用渠道并将最低级别设为警告。: No Feishu or Telegram channels are available. Enable a channel and set its minimum severity to warning.
留空日期生成上一完整周期；指定日期生成该日期所在的完整周或月。生成后会通知已订阅: Leave the date blank for the previous complete period, or select a date within the desired week or month. Subscribed channels are notified after generation; you can also send the report manually from its details.
报告趋势图：仅文本，未配置上传凭据: Report chart: text only, upload credentials not configured
应用机器人须填写应用 ID、密钥和群聊 ID。: Enter the app ID, app secret, and group chat ID.
飞书应用消息发送失败，请检查机器人权限和接收目标: Feishu app message failed; check bot permissions and the recipient
请启用并发布应用机器人，授予发送消息和上传图片权限，并将机器人加入目标群。测试发: Enable and publish the application bot, grant message and image upload permissions, and add it to the target group. Test messages verify text only; send a report to verify images.
更改接收对象并保存后，旧配置下未完成的投递会取消。: Saving a different recipient cancels unfinished deliveries for the previous configuration.
填写当前飞书应用对应的用户 Open ID，接收人须在应用可用范围内。: Enter the user's Open ID for this Feishu app. The recipient must be within the app's availability scope.
请启用并发布应用机器人，授予发送消息和上传图片权限。测试发送只验证文字，报告图片: Enable and publish the application bot and grant message and image upload permissions. Test messages verify text only; send a report to verify images.
应用机器人须填写应用 ID、密钥和有效的接收目标。: Enter the app ID, app secret, and a valid recipient.
已配置个人接收者，可在渠道列表重新绑定。: A recipient is configured; use the channel list to rebind.
保存后渠道暂不启用，请在渠道列表点击“绑定个人”，通过飞书私聊发送绑定指令。: The channel is saved disabled. Select Bind recipient in the channel list and send the command to the bot in Feishu.
请将下面的指令发送给飞书应用机器人，绑定码 10 分钟内有效，只能使用一次。: Send this command to the Feishu application bot. The code expires after 10 minutes and can only be used once.
等待用户发送指令: Waiting for the recipient to send the command
同一应用的凭据或代理不一致: App credentials or proxy settings differ between channels
连接中或未连接，请检查飞书权限与网络: Connecting or disconnected; check Feishu permissions and network
绑定成功。新渠道需要在列表中启用后才会接收通知。: Binding succeeded. Enable a new channel in the list to receive notifications.
请在渠道列表点击“绑定个人”，绑定成功后自动切换目标。: Select Bind recipient in the channel list; the target changes after binding succeeds.
解除个人绑定会停用渠道并取消待处理通知，确定继续吗？: Removing the recipient disables the channel and cancels pending notifications. Continue?
更换应用后渠道将停用，需要重新绑定个人接收者。: Changing the application disables the channel until the personal recipient is rebound.
